notes.title: Added sound spatializer selection
notes.notes: [p]With this update, the ability to select the spatializer in real time by pressing a key is introduced.[/p][p]The implemented options are the following:[/p][p]key "6" - Unity's basic spatializer[/p][p]key "7" - Steam Audio[/p][p]key "8" - Google Resonance[/p][p]key "9" - Atmoki[/p][p]key "0" - MichelSpaz, a spatializer that I programmed from scratch based on physical calculations of how sound reaches the ears, which I later modified to obtain a more artistic than real effect.[/p]
